briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier scaling as safety gaps widen in production deployments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with major labs pushing multimodal agents and reasoning models amid regulatory scrutiny. Compute constraints and talent wars define strategic positioning. Prompt injection attacks continue to expose enterprise systems at scale.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4 model family shows gains in long-horizon planning while Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus with enhanced tool use. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3.5 and Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. xAI ships Grok-3 with real-time knowledge integration.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New red-team reports highlight persistent alignment failures in agentic workflows. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly with TSMC expanding CoWoS capacity. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters in Texas and Arizona. Energy demand forecasts push utilities toward dedicated nuclear restarts.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from an open-weight lab or remain locked behind corporate API walls?
